# Sending window: queue three segments, flush at t=0 (all due, transmit=1),
# flush again at t=50 (rto 100, nothing due), retransmit at t=100.
sw_new
sw_push 1 hello
sw_push 2 world
sw_push 3 ferrox
sw_flush 0 100 10
sw_flush 50 100 10
sw_flush 100 100 10
sw_fastack 2 100
sw_flush 150 100 10
# One more: only the first two due at t=150, fast ack cut one's timeout.
sw_remove 2
sw_len
sw_first
# Ack list: three numbers, flush twice with different rto, clear prefix.
al_new 1350
al_add 1 100
al_add 2 110
al_add 3 120
al_flush 0 100
al_flush 50 100
al_clear 2
al_flush 60 100
al_flush 200 100
# RTT estimator: a couple of samples, cap probe, peer rto adoption.
rtt_update 100 0
rtt_timeout
rtt_update 200 100
rtt_timeout
rtt_peer 300 200
rtt_timeout
rtt_peer 400 4000
rtt_timeout
